payload.reason: active settled turn total drift budget exceeded

measurement_contract.drift_path: sum raw odometry pose XY chord from activation anchor; no SLAM or map-to-odom transform
measurement_contract.limits: Instantaneous speeds and finite-interval chords are distinct; small ongoing real XY motion can exceed a fixed cumulative whole-segment budget without a speed violation.
measurement_contract.producer_pose: model WorldPose, copied directly to odom pose
measurement_contract.producer_velocity: Model WorldLinearVel delegates to canonical Link origin velocity; ODE offset subtracts CoG before dBodyGetRelPointVel; not bare CoG velocity
measurement_contract.projection: world XY rotated by float yaw via cosf/sinf; no z input and no reference-point translation
measurement_contract.rest_speed: hypot raw linear.x/linear.y, not xyz; linear.z only finite-checked
